heroHeadline: Trump Bans CNN, MS NOW and Politico From White House as Fed Hikes Rates and a GOP Ally Breaks on Immigration
heroSubtitle: President Trump announced Friday, September 18, 2026 (Day 609) that he is 'banning' CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House over their coverage, a ban enforced the next morning when reporters from the outlets were denied entry and had press badges confiscated by Secret Service; all three outlets said they would pursue legal action on First Amendment grounds. The press fight capped a rough week for the administration: the Federal Reserve on September 16 raised interest rates a quarter point to 3.75%–4.00% — its first hike in over three years — citing inflation pressure from Iran-war-driven fuel costs, and Rep. María Elvira Salazar, a Trump-endorsed Miami Republican, released a campaign ad September 17 saying his immigration enforcement has 'gone too far' and warning he is losing Hispanic voters ahead of the midterms. The developments followed Trump's September 14 return from Ireland to campaign for Republican candidates, and came alongside a Fox News poll (fielded Sep 11-14) putting his approval at 39% and finding 63% of voters believe his administration has made the economy worse.
